flows.soil: Leptosols + Cambisols — mountain skeletal, Z-Boson foundation
Arenosols + Solonchaks — desert sand, saline quark-tension
Fluvisols + Vertisols — alluvial river clay, water-retentive
Nitisols (Ethiopian highlands) + Solonchaks (Dallol) — iron-rich red clay
Ferralsols + Plinthosols — iron oxide, tropical deep weathering
Podzols + Gleysols — acidic waterlogged, nu-leach + h-cold
Anthrosols + Acrisols — rice paddy, tropical weathered
Anthrosols + Fluvisols — rice/millet paddy, alluvial river plain
Kastanozems + Cryosols — steppe chestnut, permafrost lock
Fluvisols + Arenosols — Nile alluvial + desert sand
Vertisols + Nitisols — black cotton soil, tropical iron-rich
